_comment: Official Proton Linux packages. VPN: Proton's apt repository, set up by its release package (SHA-256 from https://protonvpn.com/support/official-linux-vpn-debian). Pass and Mail: official .deb downloads, verified against the SHA-512 in Proton's version.json (https://proton.me/support/set-up-proton-pass-linux, https://proton.me/support/set-up-proton-mail-linux).
